en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 74 points at 24345
en.dek: The benchmark recovered from an early slide to finish higher on Tuesday, with financial and property stocks among the gainers while technology shares remained mixed.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed higher on Tuesday after trimming earlier losses, finishing up about 74 points at 24,345, according to reports.
The index had opened lower and briefly dipped toward 23,988 before recovering. Financial and property stocks contributed to the afternoon rebound, while the technology index ended mixed.
Turnover was reported in the region of HK$180 billion or higher. The previous session on Monday had closed at 24,271.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收升74點報24345點
zh.dek: 恒指周二早段下跌後午後回升，金融及地產股向上，科技股則表現參差。
body: 恒生指數周二收市上升約74點，報24345點，由早段跌幅收復。
指數低開後曾一度跌近23988點，午後回升。金融及地產股帶動午後升幅，科技指數則有升有跌。
成交額據報約1800億元或以上。周一收市報24271點。
